column1: # The tracked lines that name a licence term, as tools/check-licence-names.py searches for
# them. 1 row per kind of line in a file: path, count, owner, marker, separated by tabs.
# The count is the number of matching lines of that path that hold the marker, matched with
# its letter case; every matching line of a path must hold the marker of exactly 1 row.
# Owner: unit-2 or unit-3 changes the line in that unit of TODO 243; keep stays as it is.
# The gate refuses an owner other than unit-2, unit-3 or keep; whether the owner is right is reviewed.
